hikou.name: Hikou
hikou.description: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.

hikou-prime.name: Hikou Prime
hikou-prime.description: As deadly as any bullet without the associated noise or commotion.

hystrix.name: Hystrix
hystrix.description: Heat, cold, electricity, or toxin: choose an element and launch a flurry of deadly quills. This versatile sidearm is Khora’s signature weapon and has a chance to instantly reload after headshots when she wields it.

hystrix-prime.name: Hystrix Prime
hystrix-prime.description: Versatile weapons complement deadly hunters. Khora Prime’s signature pistol rotates through hot, cold, electric, and toxic quills. When equipped on Khora, Hystrix Prime has a chance to instantly reload after headshots.
